import re

pattern = r'^([-+ ]?\d+|[-+ ]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[-+ ]?0[bB][01]+|[-+ ]?0[oO][0-7]+)$'

# With DOTALL flag
m = re.match(pattern, '42\n', re.DOTALL)
print(f'Match with DOTALL: {m}')
if m:
    print(f'  groups: {m.groups()}')

# Without DOTALL
m = re.match(pattern, '42\n')
print(f'Match without DOTALL: {m}')
"
